why_this_document_exists: Frozen normalization constants whose values must be selected from measurement resolution or the fixed capability universe before any scored result is observed. They are reusable scientific inputs, not results from a historical run.

semantic_determinacy.raw_metric: mean over probes of log2(B_i), where B_i is the count of materially different semantic interpretations compatible with the local surface form
semantic_determinacy.zero_means: every probe has exactly one compatible interpretation (B_i = 1 for all i), so log2(B_i) = 0 everywhere
semantic_determinacy.epsilon_derivation: 1/44. The smallest observable change in the mean is one probe moving from B=1 to B=2, i.e. log2(2)=1 spread over the 44 fixed probes.

semantic_locality.raw_metric: total required external semantic lookups / declaration-graph hops across all frozen locality rows
semantic_locality.zero_means: every frozen semantic fact is resolvable without leaving the probe fragment
semantic_locality.epsilon_derivation: one lookup hop — the measurement is a whole count and cannot resolve less than one hop

hidden_semantic_cost.raw_metric: count of frozen checklist behaviours that may occur without being signalled at the use site
hidden_semantic_cost.zero_means: no frozen hidden-behaviour row fires for that language
hidden_semantic_cost.epsilon_derivation: one hidden behaviour — the measurement is a whole count

capability_efficiency.raw_metric: semantic complexity units per supported capability point
capability_efficiency.zero_means: not reachable: a language that supports any capability requires at least one syntax form to express it
capability_efficiency.epsilon_derivation: unshifted form applies; a zero raw here would be a measurement defect and is surfaced as such rather than scored as perfect

timing_and_resource_metrics.raw_metric: execution time, CPU time, compile time, startup latency, peak RSS, source bytes, binary size, deployment footprint, source tokens, total tokens
timing_and_resource_metrics.zero_means: not reachable for a program that actually ran and produced output
timing_and_resource_metrics.epsilon_derivation: unshifted form applies. A measured zero indicates the harness failed to observe the run rather than that the run was free, and the timing harness self-test explicitly checks that a failed command is reported as a failure and not as a numeric zero.

semantic_density_family.reason: positive higher-is-better quantity with no natural 0-1 bound (spec 25.1.D names Semantic Density explicitly). Score_i = 100 * raw_i / best_raw.
semantic_density_family.raw_metric: explicit local semantic sites / lexical source tokens
semantic_density_family.numerator_rule: count of frozen site_id rows whose evidence state is EXPLICIT_LOCAL; each site_id contributes at most one unless its own frozen multiplicity_rule says otherwise. NONLOCAL, IMPLICIT, ABSENT and UNSUPPORTED rows never enter the numerator.
semantic_density_family.denominator_rule: lexical source tokens of the measured fragment only, counted by the single frozen tokenizer scripts/tokenize_probe.py, applied in one authoritative pass to all ten languages. Comments and whitespace are not tokens.

capability_coverage.formula: C = 100 * supported capability points / total fixed capability points
capability_coverage.unsupported_stays_in_denominator: A capability the language does not support remains in the denominator and lowers coverage. It is never N/A (spec 26).

semantic_compression_overall.zero_case: if Q + C = 0 the score is 0
semantic_compression_overall.no_substitution: The harmonic mean is fixed in advance so that neither high semantic quality with trivial coverage nor broad coverage with poor semantic quality can dominate. It is not replaced by a weighted arithmetic mean after results are known.

clipping_and_precision.raw_precision: full available precision retained in raw evidence
clipping_and_precision.reported_precision: normalized metric and evaluation scores reported to two decimal places
clipping_and_precision.ranking_uses: unrounded values; displayed rounding never decides a tie
